nodes.name: Electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: The NiFe LDH was grown on nickel foam (NF) via a simple electrodeposition method as reported elsewhere [6,29]. Detailed preparation procedure is described in the Experimental Section and Supporting Information (Figure S1 and Table S1).
nodes.source_text: Schematic illustration for the preparation of NiFe LDH-POMs is shown in Figure 1a. The NiFe LDH was grown on nickel foam (NF) via a simple electrodeposition method as reported elsewhere,[6,29]

nodes.name: PMo12 Wet Etching
nodes.procedure: Etching treatment of electrodeposited NiFe LDH on nickel foam with phosphomolybdic acid (pure PMo12). The NiFe LDH-PMo12 at pH 2.5 exhibited optimal performance. Detailed preparation procedure is described in the Experimental Section and Supporting Information (Figure S1 and Table S1). Possible reaction equation provided in Note S1.
nodes.source_text: followed by the etching treatment of POMs or common inorganic acids. In the work, we chose three typical Keggin-structured POMs, i.e., ... phosphomolybdic acid (pure PMo12)... The results show that the NiFe LDH-PMo12 at pH 2.5 exhibited the best OER performance

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows reduced crystallite size and crystallinity in NiFe LDH-PMo12 with negative shift of ≈0.4° for (00n) peak and increased interlayer distance.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of NiFe LDH-PMo12 (Figure S8a, Supporting Information) reveal the constituent nanosheets both in size and crystallinity are reduced.

nodes.characterization_summary: FTIR confirms reduction of nanosheet thickness and presence of ion-exchanged PMo12 polyanionic clusters.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectra (Figures S8b and S9a, Supporting Information)... also confirm the reduction of nanosheets thickness and existence of ion-exchanged PMo12 polyanionic clusters.

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman confirms reduction of nanosheet thickness and presence of ion-exchanged PMo12 polyanionic clusters.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Raman spectra (Figures S8c and S9b, Supporting Information) of the as-synthesized samples also confirm the reduction of nanosheets thickness and existence of ion-exchanged PMo12 polyanionic clusters.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-OES detects trace W in NiFe LDH-PW12/SiW12 and Mo in NiFe LDH-PMo12; Fe concentration lower in etched samples indicating Fe vacancies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES) measurements show that the W elements for NiFe LDH-PW12 and NiFe LDH-SiW12 and Mo elements for NiFe LDH-PMo12 can be detected in a trace amount...

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-MS shows Ni/Fe ratio of 4.5:1 and P/Mo of 1:3.3 in electrodeposited NiFe LDH-PMo12; P and Mo contents 1.2 and 12.2 μg/cm².
nodes.evidence_snippet: We further applied inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) to detect the amount of constituent elements in NiFe LDH-PMo12... The atomic ratio of Ni/Fe and P/Mo are nearly equal to 4.5:1 and 1:3.3...

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS shows Ni/Fe≈2:1, α-Ni(OH)₂ content increases from 8.6% (NiFe LDH) to 43.7% (NiFe LDH-PMo12), Fe 2p3/2 shifts +0.6 eV indicating Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺, OIII (oxygen vacancy) ratio 23.66% vs 22.53%, P 2p at 133.84 eV for PO₄³⁻.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Table S2 in the Supporting Information shows the corresponding Ni/Fe ratios are ≈2 (±0.2):1... Typically, the amount of α-Ni(OH)₂ is significantly increased from only 8.6% in NiFe LDH to 43.7% in NiFe LDH-PMo12... After the PMo12 etching, a 0.6 eV shift of Fe 2p3/2 peak toward higher binding energy...

nodes.characterization_summary: EPR shows increased oxygen vacancy signal intensity at g=2.004, nearly twice higher in NiFe LDH-PMo12; Fe³⁺ signals at g=2.16 and 4.32.
nodes.evidence_snippet: We further conducted the electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy to verify the oxygen vacancy levels (Figure 2b). The EPR signal intensities... at g = 2.004, corresponding to structural defects induced oxygen vacancies...
